3. **Owner promotion required.** No packet can be promoted to a canonical rule or config
   change without an explicit owner action (editing `LESSONS.md` to move the entry to
   the promoted section and opening a Tier 2 PR if a script or schema changes). The agent
   cannot self-promote.
normalized_decision: No knowledge packet can be promoted to a canonical rule or config change without an explicit owner action; the agent cannot self-promote.
candidate_rule: Knowledge packet promotion to canonical rule/config requires explicit owner action; agent cannot self-promote
human_notes: Approved candidate boundary. Source: ADR-010 lines 25-28. Explicit-owner promotion gate only. Does not absorb repo-local evidence requirements, packet-generation mechanics, or future promotion automation.
